description: This file defines the AOS_Contracts class for SuiteCRM, extending AOS_Contracts_sugar, with methods for handling contract reminders, saving, deletion, and linking calls.

classes.name: AOS_Contracts
classes.description: A CRM contract class with methods for managing reminders, saving, deletion, and call linking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the contract, setting default renewal reminder date based on configuration and end date.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the contract, handling duplicate and renewal reminder logic, and saving related line item groups.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the contract and associated product lines as deleted, and deletes related calls.

methods.name: createReminder
methods.description: Creates a call reminder for contract renewal.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a link (call) associated with the contract for renewal reminders.

methods.name: deleteCall
methods.description: Deletes the call associated with the contract.
